data.text: I want our neighbors to get treatment, Luke, but let’s confirm the clinic’s request and arrange any payment directly to them before pledging our catch. I support Emma’s 50-ton limit. With you taking zero, the four of us could each catch 12.5 tons, raising $50,000 without reducing next month’s stock. Let’s ask the clinic whether village donations or a short advance could cover the remaining $10,000 today. If a verified emergency truly requires the extra catch, I’d consider 15 tons only with everyone agreeing to next month’s 30-ton total cap. Luke, can you show us the request and confirm whether those alternatives are possible?
